heading: Tuesday Night
text: Becoming partly cloudy south. Mostly cloudy north, with scattered evening showers. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s, with some mid 40s northeast, and some upper 50s in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph and diminishing, except remaining in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly to mostly sunny. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Partly cloudy, then clouds increasing late. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s east of the Greens, mid 50s to around 60 west. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, and gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.
